'''The Wood Grouse Dances''' is a [[sword form]]. Aside from the name, nothing is know about it.

==In practice==
In the duel between [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Turak Aladon]] in [[Falme]], this form was used to meet [[Moon on the Water]].{{ref/book|2|45}} [[Gawyn Trakand]] used this form as he fought [[Aiel]] after the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].{{ref/book|7|p}} [[Eamon Valda]] used this form to cut a shallow gash on [[Galadedrid Damodred]]'s shoulder during thier [[Trial Beneath the Light]].{{ref/book|11|p}}
